# RPG Zzu: Modern RPG Maker Editor & Runtime Analysis

## Project Introduction

RPG Zzu is a comprehensive modernization of the classic RPG Maker ecosystem, providing both an advanced editor for game creation and a powerful runtime for executing RPG games. This project represents a significant evolution in RPG development tools, combining the familiar RPG Maker workflow with modern web technologies and AI-assisted development capabilities.

### Purpose Statement
RPG Zzu aims to bridge the gap between traditional RPG Maker workflows and modern development practices by offering:
- A browser-based RPG game editor with enhanced productivity features
- Full compatibility with RPG Maker 2003 (RM2K3) format and assets
- AI-powered assistance for game development tasks
- Modern web deployment capabilities with PWA support

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Fidelity**: Maintain complete compatibility with RM2K3 game files and behavior
- **Accessibility**: Provide a modern, web-based development experience
- **Productivity**: Enhance authoring workflows with intelligent tools and automation
- **Extensibility**: Support plugins, custom tilesets, and community contributions

### Target Audience
- RPG game developers seeking modern tooling
- Existing RPG Maker users wanting to upgrade their workflow
- Indie game developers interested in turn-based RPG mechanics
- Educational institutions teaching game development concepts

## Technical Architecture

The project follows a modular architecture built on modern TypeScript and web technologies, with clear separation between editor, runtime, and shared components.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Main Entry Point] --> B[Editor System]
    A --> C[Runtime System]
    A --> D[AI Assistant]
    
    B --> E[Map Editor]
    B --> F[Database Manager]
    B --> G[Event Editor]
    B --> H[Tileset Editor]
    
    C --> I[Battle System]
    C --> J[World Navigation]
    C --> K[Dialogue System]
    C --> L[Save/Load System]
    
    D --> M[LLM Integration]
    D --> N[Context Builder]
    D --> O[Tool Registry]
    
    E --> P[Tile Rendering Engine]
    F --> Q[Data Persistence]
    G --> R[Command Execution]
```

### Component Breakdown

The architecture is organized into several key subsystems:

**Core Systems:**
- **Application Shell**: Main entry point and lifecycle management
- **State Management**: Centralized application state with reactive updates
- **Asset Pipeline**: Dynamic loading and caching of game resources
- **Plugin System**: Extensible architecture for custom functionality

**Editor Components:**
- **Map Editor**: Visual tile-based map creation and editing
- **Database Manager**: Comprehensive data record management
- **Event System**: Visual event scripting interface
- **Tileset Editor**: Advanced tileset creation and modification tools

**Runtime Components:**
- **Game Engine**: Phaser.js-based rendering and input handling
- **Battle System**: Turn-based combat with customizable mechanics
- **Navigation System**: World traversal and scene transitions
- **Persistence Layer**: Save/load functionality with cloud sync

### Design Patterns

The project implements several key design patterns:

1. **Command Pattern**: For undo/redo functionality and event processing
2. **Observer Pattern**: For reactive UI updates and state synchronization
3. **Factory Pattern**: For creating different types of game objects
4. **Strategy Pattern**: For pluggable battle systems and rendering backends
5. **Repository Pattern**: For data access abstraction

### System Relationships

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as User Interface
    participant Editor as Editor Core
    participant DataStore as Data Store
    participant AssetMgr as Asset Manager
    participant Renderer as Game Renderer
    
    User->>+Editor: Create Map
    Editor->>+DataStore: Initialize Project
    DataStore-->>-Editor: Project Context
    Editor->>+AssetMgr: Load Tilesets
    AssetMgr-->>-Editor: Asset References
    Editor->>+Renderer: Render Preview
    Renderer-->>-User: Visual Feedback
```

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

The application bootstraps through multiple entry points depending on the execution context:

- **Main Application**: `src/main.ts` - Primary editor entry point
- **Player Mode**: `player.html` - Standalone game runtime
- **Development Server**: Vite-based hot reload configuration
- **Build Scripts**: Comprehensive build and deployment automation

### Core Modules

**Project Structure Organization:**
- `src/app/` - Application core and lifecycle management
- `src/editor/` - Complete editor system with panels and tools
- `src/player/` - Game runtime and engine components
- `src/battle/` - Turn-based battle system implementation
- `src/project/` - Project data models and persistence
- `src/ai/` - AI assistant integration and tool orchestration

**Key Configuration Files:**
- `vite.config.ts` - Development server and build configuration
- `tsconfig.json` - TypeScript compilation settings
- `package.json` - Dependencies and scripts management
- `playwright.config.ts` - End-to-end testing configuration

### External Dependencies

The project leverages several key external libraries:

**Core Framework:**
- **Phaser 3**: Game engine for rendering and input handling
- **TypeScript**: Type-safe development environment
- **Vite**: Fast build tool and development server

**UI and State Management:**
- **React**: Component-based user interface
- **Zustand**: Lightweight state management
- **Tailwind CSS**: Utility-first styling framework

**Data and Persistence:**
- **Supabase**: Cloud database and authentication
- **IndexedDB**: Local storage for offline capability
- **JSON Schema**: Data validation and documentation

### Integration Points

**External Service Integrations:**
- **OpenAI API**: AI-powered assistance and content generation
- **Supabase**: Real-time collaboration and cloud storage
- **GitHub**: Version control integration and project hosting

**Asset Pipeline Integration:**
- **EasyRPG RTP**: Compatibility with official RPG Maker assets
- **Custom Tileset Formats**: Support for various sprite sheet formats
- **Audio Processing**: Dynamic music and sound effect handling

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Asset Sources] --> B[Asset Pipeline]
    B --> C[Generated Assets]
    C --> D[Runtime Loading]
    
    E[External APIs] --> F[Integration Layer]
    F --> G[Service Abstractions]
    G --> H[Application Services]
    
    I[User Input] --> J[Input Handler]
    J --> K[Action Queue]
    K --> L[Command Processor]
```

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Advanced Map Editing:**
- Visual tile-based map creation with real-time preview
- Intelligent autotile system for seamless terrain connections
- Multi-layer support for backgrounds, foregrounds, and collision
- Region-based editing for large-scale world construction

**Comprehensive Database Management:**
- Complete RPG Maker 2003 database compatibility
- Visual record editors with rich media previews
- Cross-reference validation and integrity checking
- Bulk operations and import/export capabilities

**AI-Powered Development Assistant:**
- Context-aware code completion and suggestions
- Automated asset generation and optimization
- Intelligent error detection and repair
- Natural language command interface

**Modern Battle System:**
- Fully customizable turn-based combat mechanics
- Animated character sprites with pose system
- Dynamic backdrop and visual effects
- Balance testing and simulation tools

### Implementation Highlights

**Tile Rendering Engine**: `src/editor/chipsetTileRender.ts`
- High-performance canvas-based tile rendering
- Dynamic transparency and blending modes
- Optimized batch rendering for large maps
- Real-time preview with zoom and pan support

**Event Command System**: `src/editor/eventCommands/`
- Visual event scripting with drag-and-drop interface
- Rich form builders for complex parameter inputs
- Live preview and debugging capabilities
- Template system for common event patterns

**Battle Animation System**: `src/battle/animationSnapshot.ts`
- Frame-by-frame animation capture and playback
- Interpolation between keyframes for smooth motion
- Event-driven animation triggers and callbacks
- Performance profiling and optimization tools

**Resource Management**: `src/assets/`
- Lazy loading with intelligent prefetching
- Memory-efficient texture atlases
- Format conversion and optimization pipeline
- Cache invalidation and update strategies

### Feature Architecture

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Editing: Open Project
    Editing --> Preview: Play Test
    Preview --> Editing: Return to Editor
    Editing --> Saving: Auto-save Trigger
    Saving --> Editing: Save Complete
    Editing --> Exporting: Build Game
    Exporting --> [*]: Export Complete
    Editing --> Error: Validation Failure
    Error --> Editing: Fix Issues
```

**Testing Infrastructure:**
- Comprehensive unit test suite covering all major features
- End-to-end tests simulating real user workflows
- Performance benchmarking and regression detection
- Visual regression testing for UI consistency

**Development Tools:**
- Hot module replacement for rapid iteration
- Debug overlays and performance monitoring
- Asset inspection and analysis utilities
- Automated code quality checks and formatting
